content.text: https://bit.ly/34Nh7jC Welcome to the Imarticus Learning YouTube channel! If you've been asking yourself, "How do I start investing?" or "What is investing?" – then you're in the right place! This video will simplify the world of investing, making it easy and fun for beginners to get started. This video will walk you through the core basics of investing, why it's essential for beating inflation, and how you can start with just a small amount of money. Whether you’re looking to build wealth, protect yourself from inflation, or simply understand how to put your money to work, this video breaks it all down step-by-step. https://bit.ly/34Nh7jC What will you learn? 👉What is Investing?: Learn how investing helps grow your money over time. 👉Why Should You Invest?: Understand the role of inflation and how investing keeps you ahead. 👉Types of Investments: Stocks, bonds, real estate, and more – we break it all down. 👉How to Start Investing: Follow a simple, actionable roadmap to start your investing journey!
